h1: How El Ingenio turns its visitors' behavior into business decisions
sub: El Ingenio Shopping Center chooses Flame Analytics to better understand its visitors' behavior, optimize the management of the center and improve the customer experience through digital services powered by WiFi connectivity.

quote.text: The digital transformation of a shopping center begins by understanding how its visitors behave and using that information to continuously improve their experience.
quote.author: Management team

elCaso: El Ingenio Shopping Center, managed by MVGM, has driven a digitalization strategy aimed at getting to know its visitors better and improving the management of the asset through the intelligent use of data.

Together with Flame Analytics, the center incorporates a platform that combines customer behavior analytics with digital services tied to WiFi connectivity, improving both the visitor experience and the management team's analytical capabilities.
The result is a management model based on objective information, where every interaction helps to better understand how the shopping center works and enables more efficient decision-making.

blocks.h2: Understanding better how visitors use the shopping center

body.p: Shopping centers welcome thousands of people every week, but knowing footfall alone does not always make it possible to understand how visitors interact with the space.
El Ingenio wanted to add a more complete view that would answer questions such as:

list: How do visitor flows evolve throughout the day?
What behavior patterns do customers show?
How can the experience be improved during the visit?
How can digital services be leveraged to generate greater value?
How can we obtain information that helps optimize campaigns and operations?
How can data be turned into a tool for daily management?

body.quote: The goal was to have a platform capable of connecting the visitor experience with the shopping center's business intelligence.

blocks.h2: Behavior analytics and a connected digital experience

body.p: Flame Analytics deployed a solution that combines visitor behavior analytics with digital services tied to the shopping center's WiFi connectivity.

Thanks to this platform, El Ingenio can better understand how customers interact with the space, analyze behavior patterns and have useful information to optimize operational and commercial management.

WiFi connectivity not only improves the visitor experience during their stay, but also facilitates the generation of first-party data that enriches customer knowledge and enables more relevant marketing actions.
All the information is centralized in dashboards that offer a continuous view of the center's activity and support data-driven decision-making.
The project was designed to turn the data generated by the shopping center into a cross-cutting management tool.

The combination of analytics, connectivity and visitor knowledge makes it possible to optimize campaigns, improve the customer experience and strengthen the relationship between the shopping center and its audience.
With Flame Analytics, El Ingenio has a far more complete view of its visitors' behavior.
Teams can analyze footfall patterns, get to know their customers better and evaluate the impact of different commercial actions through up-to-date, centralized information.

body.h3: From visitor behavior to shopping-center intelligence

body.p: The project marks a step forward in El Ingenio's digital transformation strategy.

The combination of behavior analytics and digital services tied to WiFi makes it possible to turn every visit into useful business knowledge, helping to optimize daily operations and build a closer relationship with visitors.
Thanks to Flame Analytics, the shopping center has a platform that turns data into a strategic tool to continuously improve the customer experience and the asset's performance.
